metaTitle: Custom Folding Multi Function Tools | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom folding multi function tools for your team. Perfect for giveaways and safety kits at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Folding multi function tools combine portability with practicality, making them a go-to choice for trade shows, employee gifts, and safety kits. The folding design keeps the tool compact when not in use while still offering pliers, knives, screwdrivers, and more. Choose from stainless steel or aluminum handles, and add your logo via laser engraving or pad printing. These tools are a durable, everyday carry item that recipients will keep for years.
heroAltText: Custom folding multi function tool with stainless steel body and engraved logo, displayed open with pliers and knife blade visible.
